retrieved_via: web text rendering; manually normalized selected factual fields
immutable_content_note: History exposes this commit, but direct retrieval of the immutable raw URL failed. The master data cannot yet be asserted byte-identical to the commit.

selection.all: Positive legacy weight, no attribute, no probabilistic hit rate, no special defense effect.
selection.weapon: attackKind ATK; attackExtra empty or INCREASE_ATK; defenseKind empty or DFS.
selection.armor: defenseKind DFS; attackKind empty; attackExtra empty or INCREASE_ATK.
selection.sundry: attackKind INCREASE_HP or INCREASE_MP; no attackExtra; no defense role.

limitations: Subset only; unsupported IDs are rejected, not converted to plain attacks.
Legacy IDs are original zero-based CSV row indices, not current official IDs.
Labels are technical IDs, not verified official names or current-card mappings.
Weights are old emulator weights. Its README warns that the distribution may be inaccurate.
Sampling normalized over this allowlist is a restricted curriculum, not official acquisition probabilities.
MAGIC, TRADE, elemental/status/reflect/counter/guardian effects are excluded.
Sundry attack booster legacy ID 238 is excluded until a separate kind is supported.
Current official-client compatibility has not been verified.
